purpose: Deterministic Stage A observations transcribed from a filed SEC earnings exhibit and supported by filed periodic reports.

reporting_entity.entity_boundary_warning: These SEC observations belong to the consolidated SEC registrant. They must not be assigned to Truist Bank or combined with bank regulatory observations without an explicit entity relationship and scope assessment.

reporting_scope.excluded_population: Commercial mortgage servicing and other consumer loan servicing unless a metric explicitly states otherwise
reporting_scope.scope_note: Truist reports Consumer and Small Business Banking and Wholesale Banking as its two reportable segments. The selected mortgage servicing table is a consolidated residential mortgage disclosure, not a standalone servicing segment.

source_evidence.filing_status_basis: The Form 8-K states that Exhibit 99.2 is deemed filed for purposes of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
source_evidence.locator: Selected Mortgage Banking Information & Additional Information, page 9, As of/For the Quarter Ended table

bounded_exact_excerpt.normalization: Filed HTML table text with whitespace and column separators normalized; labels and displayed values are unchanged.
bounded_exact_excerpt.text:
As of/For the Quarter Ended | June 30 2026 | March 31 2026 | Dec. 31 2025 | Sept. 30 2025 | June 30 2025
Residential mortgage servicing income before MSR valuation | 70 | 82 | 77 | 74 | 72
Loans serviced for others | 240,764 | 233,870 | 228,383 | 221,274 | 213,002
Bank-owned loans serviced | 57,894 | 57,386 | 57,583 | 58,396 | 57,748
Total servicing portfolio | 298,658 | 291,256 | 285,966 | 279,670 | 270,750
Weighted-average servicing fee on mortgage loans serviced for others | 0.29 | 0.29 | 0.28 | 0.28 | 0.28

source_evidence.locator: Note 6, Loan Servicing, Residential Mortgage Activities

bounded_exact_excerpt.normalization: Filed HTML paragraph text with whitespace normalized; wording is unchanged.
bounded_exact_excerpt.text: The Company acquires servicing rights and retains servicing rights related to certain of its sales or securitizations of residential mortgages, commercial mortgages, and other consumer loans. Servicing rights are capitalized by the Company as Loan servicing rights on the Consolidated Balance Sheets. Income earned by the Company on its loan servicing rights is derived primarily from contractually specified servicing fees, late fees, net of curtailment costs, and other ancillary fees.
